title: MusicDiscEffects
description: if a player holds a music disc it gives them a 1x effect
body:
# 🎵 **MusicDiscEffects**

**MusicDiscEffects** is a lightweight Paper/Spigot plugin that gives **custom potion effects** whenever a player is *holding a music disc* in their main-hand or off-hand.

Perfect for SMPs, PvP servers, RPG worlds, or any server where you want music discs to matter.

Each disc grants a **unique, configurable potion effect**, applied instantly and removed cleanly when the disc is no longer held.

---

## ✨ **Disc Effects**

| Music Disc           | Effect              | Level |
| -------------------- | ------------------- | ----- |
| *Tears*              | Strength            | I     |
| *Lava Chicken*       | Strength            | II    |
| *5*                  | Resistance          | I     |
| *Pigstep*            | Fire Resistance     | I     |
| *11*                 | Invisibility        | I     |
| *13*                 | Night Vision        | I     |
| *Cat*                | Luck                | VI    |
| *Mellohi*            | Conduit Power       | I     |
| *Wait*               | Dolphin’s Grace     | I     |
| *Chirp*              | Slow Falling        | I     |
| *Creator: Music Box* | Haste               | I     |
| *Relic*              | Haste               | II    |
| *Precipice*          | Speed               | I     |
| *Creator*            | Speed               | II    |
| *Otherside*          | Health Boost        | I     |
| *Far*                | Jump Boost          | I     |
| *Blocks*             | Jump Boost          | II    |
| *Stal*               | Water Breathing     | I     |
| *Strad*              | Hero of the Village | I     |
| *Ward*               | Hero of the Village | II    |
| *Mall*               | Hero of the Village | III   |

---

## ⚙️ **Features**

* 🎧 Unique effects for every disc
* ↔️ Main-hand & off-hand support
* ♾️ Infinite or timed effects
* 🧪 Configurable effect types & levels
* 🛡 Metadata-safe effect handling
* 📜 Simple YAML config
* 🔄 Live effect updating
* 🚀 Ultra-lightweight tick system
* 🔌 Supports **Paper / Spigot 1.21.8**

---

## 🔧 **Commands & Permissions**

**Command:**

```
/music
```

**Permission:**

```
musicdisc.admin
```

Manage and configure music disc effects in-game.
